release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.43.2 adds a Stellar-style in-app update notification that surfaces a new-version prompt at launch with version details, release notes, Later, and Update Now actions while reusing Tachyon's existing verified updater path. It also extends the protected device-bound license cache into a 14-day offline lease so previously validated members are more resilient to temporary GitHub or licensing-service outages. This release also completes the private-source/public-distribution migration by publishing consumer binaries and updater manifests from private tachyon-core into the public tachyon-releases repository.
